## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Dàodì jīng* (T607) is Ān Shìgāo's 安世高 ([安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98)) one-fascicle partial Hàn-period translation of Saṅgharakṣa's 僧伽羅剎 ([僧伽羅剎](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E4%BC%BD%E7%BE%85%E5%89%8E)) Sarvāstivāda *Yogācārabhūmi* — the same Indic original of which Dharmarakṣa later produced the much fuller seven-fascicle [KR6i0243](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0243) *Xiūxíng dàodì jīng* 修行道地經 (T606).

**Abstract**

A small early-Hàn rendering of selected sections of Saṅgharakṣa's *Yogācārabhūmi*, of capital importance both for the early study of Buddhist meditation theory in China and for the historical-philological reconstruction of the Indic original. Datable to Ān Shìgāo's Luòyáng activity (148–170 CE), making it among the earliest Chinese Buddhist translations of a *śāstra* form.
